## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) and are DCO signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Commits are cryptographically signed (SSH or GPG) and show as **Verified** on GitHub — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/CodeForFire/lagebuch/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#signing-your-commits)
- [ ] `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass locally
- [ ] Changes under `src/` add **one** changelog entry in `changelog.d/` (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#changelog-entries))
- [ ] UI changes include before/after screenshots
- [ ] No real master data / personnel data committed (screenshots use fictional data)
